nav.setup_hr_hint: Departments, designations, employment types and document categories
lists.departments_help: The parts of the shop people work in.
lists.designations_help: Each job, with its hours and responsibilities. A person's hours come from their designation unless set on their record.
lists.employment_types_help: How people are employed: full-time, part-time and so on.
lists.doc_categories_help: Kinds of staff documents, who may see them, and which are needed when someone joins.
lists.task_categories_help: Checklist categories group checklists; task categories group other tasks.
lists.hours_required_help: Used to work out hours short and overtime.
lists.flex_hours_help: Time either side of the required hours that counts as neither short nor overtime.
lists.flex_start_help: Lateness and early leaving are never measured.
lists.responsibilities_help: One per line. Job descriptions are drafted from these.
lists.sensitive_help: Seen only by people allowed to see sensitive records.
lists.staff_see_help: The staff member it belongs to can see it on their record.
lists.delete_body: {name} will be removed from the list. The activity log keeps a record of it.
err.in_use: This is used by {count, plural, one {# other record} other {# other records}}, so it can't be deleted. Make it inactive instead.
